cap: Three-storey craftsman-style house on Rosemary Heights Crescent with a covered entry, single garage and landscaped front yard
Covered front entry with a teal door, flowering hydrangeas and a Japanese maple
Front living room with a bay window and wide-plank laminate floors
Kitchen island with an eating bar between two columns, a walk-in pantry and a dining area with sliding doors to the deck
Dining area open to the kitchen and a family room with a stacked-stone gas fireplace
Open-plan family room, dining area with built-in cabinets, and kitchen
Family room with a stacked-stone gas fireplace and built-in niche, with windows over the backyard and green space
Bedroom with laminate floors and a frosted-glass sliding closet

Hot tub beside a covered cedar deck in a fenced backyard that opens to a large green space
